description: Dividers are thin lines that group content in lists or other containers.

tags.devx: - Renders a semantic `<hr>`; use `orientation` for vertical dividers.
tags.a11y:
- Renders a native `<hr>`, exposing the implicit `separator` role without extra ARIA.
- Sets `aria-orientation="vertical"` when `orientation="vertical"`, since the implicit default for `separator` is horizontal.
tags.limitations: - Purely decorative; there is no `decorative`/`aria-hidden` escape hatch, so every divider is announced as a separator to assistive technology.
